prototir_sdk.name: Prototir
prototir_sdk.description: Publish on Prototir: Ready, events, scores, storage, managed AI, and Feedback & tools for testers.

feedback-tools.name: Testing tools
feedback-tools.desc: Offer testers the Console and Performance tools beside Screenshot and Comment.

is-on-prototir.description: True when the game runs inside the Prototir player.

is-feedback-open.description: True while a tester is writing feedback. Pause input while it is.

on-value-loaded.description: Triggered when Load value finishes. Read it with StoredValue(key).

key.name: Key
key.desc: The key passed to Load value.

on-ai-response.description: Triggered when Generate text succeeds. Read it with AIText(tag).

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: The tag passed to Generate text.

on-ai-error.description: Triggered when Generate text fails. Read the reason with AIError(tag).

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: The tag passed to Generate text.

on-feedback-opened.description: Triggered when a tester opens feedback. A good moment to pause.

on-feedback-closed.description: Triggered when a tester closes feedback. A good moment to resume.

ready.description: Call once the game is genuinely interactive, not while it still shows a loader.

send-event.description: Record an analytics event: 1-64 lowercase letters, numbers, _ . : or -.

data.name: Data
data.desc: Optional small JSON object, for example {"level": 2}. Leave empty for none.

save-value.description: Store a string for this prototype and player (up to 64 KiB).

load-value.description: Load a stored string. When it arrives, On value loaded fires and StoredValue(key) returns it.

generate-text.description: Ask Prototir's managed AI for text (enable AI for the prototype first). On AI response or On AI error fires with the tag.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: A name for this request, matched by the triggers.

max-tokens.name: Max tokens
max-tokens.desc: 0 for the default; Prototir may lower it.

open-comment.description: Open the comment composer, for example from a pause menu.

take-screenshot.description: Capture the frame and open screenshot feedback.

stored-value.description: The value last loaded or saved for a key, or empty.

ai-text.description: The text Generate text returned for a tag.

ai-error.description: Why Generate text failed for a tag.
